# Floret

> A small floral studio crafting hand-tied bouquets composed as gestures — where flowers are not just flowers, but emotions, feelings, and unspoken words given form.

Floret is an independent floral studio based in Bangladesh, offering signature seasonal bouquets, bespoke arrangements, and event florals. Each bouquet is hand-tied in studio with ethically sourced stems and finished with a handwritten note.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand introduction, featured collection, and overview of services.
- [Bouquet Collection](/collection): Six signature hand-tied bouquets, each composed for a particular shade of feeling.
- [Build Your Own Bouquet](/build): Interactive composer for choosing blooms, accents, wrap, ribbon, and size.
- [About Floret](/about): Studio story, values, and the craft behind every arrangement.
- [Contact](/contact): Bespoke order form, email, phone, and Instagram for inquiries.

## Featured Bouquets

- [Ethereal Blush](/product/ethereal-blush): Soft pink garden roses and cream peonies for tender moments.
- [Garden Whispers](/product/garden-whispers): Seasonal blooms in butter cream and dusty blush.
- [Romance in Bloom](/product/romance-in-bloom): Pale pink roses with baby's breath for declarations of love.
- [Sunset Serenade](/product/sunset-serenade): Apricot and amber roses for warm gratitude.
- [Midnight Velvet](/product/midnight-velvet): Burgundy roses and moody foliage for deep passion.
- [Wildflower Sonnet](/product/wildflower-sonnet): Lavender, daisies, and dried wheat for free spirits.
